(module asl-syntax/js/expr
                                                                                                  
  :x [parseExpr
      parseExprString
      parseExprToSExpr
      exprNodeKind]
  :i [(asl-syntax/core/source :a src)
      (asl-syntax/core/tree :a tr)
      (asl-syntax/core/print :a pr)
      (asl-syntax/js/lex :a lx)])

fn exprNodeKind node: tr/Node -> String
  node.kind    

fn isTriviaTok tok: tr/Token -> Bool
  (let [(k tok.kind    )]
    (or (= k "whitespace")
    (or (= k "newline")
        (= k "comment"))))

fn skipTrivia tokens: (List tr/Token) idx: Int64 len: Int64 -> Int64
  (if (>= idx len)
    idx
    (let [(tok (optionOr (listGet tokens idx) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)))]
      (if (isTriviaTok tok)
        (skipTrivia tokens (+ idx 1) len)
        idx)))

fn tokenText s: String tok: tr/Token -> String
  (optionOr (stringSlice s tok.start     tok.end    ) "")

(schema Ast
  (:f kind String)
  (:f op String)
  (:f left (Option Ast))
  (:f right (Option Ast))
  (:f extra (Option Ast))
  (:f args (List Ast))
  (:f text String)
  (:f start Int64)
  (:f end Int64))

fn makeAstLit kind: String text: String start: Int64 end: Int64 -> Ast
  (Ast :kind kind :op "" :left (none) :right (none) :extra (none) :args (list) :text text :start start :end end)

fn makeAstUnary op: String arg: Ast start: Int64 end: Int64 -> Ast
  (Ast :kind "unary" :op op :left (some arg) :right (none) :extra (none) :args (list) :text "" :start start :end end)

fn makeAstBinary op: String left: Ast right: Ast start: Int64 end: Int64 -> Ast
  (Ast :kind "binary" :op op :left (some left) :right (some right) :extra (none) :args (list) :text "" :start start :end end)

fn makeAstCond condExpr: Ast thenExpr: Ast elseExpr: Ast start: Int64 end: Int64 -> Ast
  (Ast :kind "cond" :op "?:" :left (some condExpr) :right (some thenExpr) :extra (some elseExpr) :args (list) :text "" :start start :end end)

fn makeAstCall callee: Ast args: (List Ast) start: Int64 end: Int64 -> Ast
  (Ast :kind "call" :op "()" :left (some callee) :right (none) :extra (none) :args args :text "" :start start :end end)

fn makeAstMember obj: Ast prop: String start: Int64 end: Int64 isComputed: Bool isOpt: Bool -> Ast
  (let [(op (if isOpt (if isComputed "?.[]" "?.") (if isComputed "[]" ".")))]
    (Ast :kind "member" :op op :left (some obj) :right (none) :extra (none) :args (list) :text prop :start start :end end))

fn astToSExpr ast: Ast -> String
  (let [(k ast.kind    )]
    (cond
      ((or (= k "ident") (or (= k "literal") (= k "this")))
       ast.text    )
      ((= k "unary")
       (stringConcat "(" (stringConcat ast.op     (stringConcat " " (stringConcat (astToSExpr (optionOr ast.left     ast)) ")")))))
      ((= k "binary")
       (stringConcat "(" (stringConcat ast.op     (stringConcat " " (stringConcat (astToSExpr (optionOr ast.left     ast)) (stringConcat " " (stringConcat (astToSExpr (optionOr ast.right     ast)) ")")))))))
      ((= k "cond")
       (stringConcat "(?: " (stringConcat (astToSExpr (optionOr ast.left     ast)) (stringConcat " " (stringConcat (astToSExpr (optionOr ast.right     ast)) (stringConcat " " (stringConcat (astToSExpr (optionOr ast.extra     ast)) ")")))))))
      ((= k "call")
       (let [(calleeStr (astToSExpr (optionOr ast.left     ast)))
             (argsStrs (map (fn [(a Ast)] -> String (astToSExpr a)) ast.args    ))
             (argsJoined (if (listEmpty? argsStrs) "" (stringConcat " " (stringJoin argsStrs " "))))]
         (stringConcat "(call " (stringConcat calleeStr (stringConcat argsJoined ")")))))
      ((= k "member")
       (stringConcat "(" (stringConcat ast.op     (stringConcat " " (stringConcat (astToSExpr (optionOr ast.left     ast)) (stringConcat " " (stringConcat ast.text     ")")))))))
      (else ast.text    ))))

fn parseExprString s: String -> tr/Node
  (let [(tokens (lx/tokenize s))
        (len (stringLength s))
        (elems (map (fn [(t tr/Token)] -> tr/TreeElement (tr/elemToken t)) tokens))]
    (tr/makeNode "Program" 0 len elems))

fn parseExpr s: String -> tr/Node
  (parseExprString s)

fn parseExprToSExpr s: String -> String
  (let [(tokens (lx/tokenize s))
        (len (stringLength s))
        (tok (optionOr (listGet tokens (skipTrivia tokens 0 (listLength tokens))) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)))]
    (tokenText s tok))
